sentences.text: 3. The informant is one of the investor, who has invested huge sum in digital currency upon promise of higher returns.
Since everything has became failed, the informant could not get money, hence the report.
4. It is the applicant's prime contention that there was no money transaction in his favour.
We have been taken through the FIR stating that the Scheme was allegedly floated by accused nos. 1 to 4 and they had accepted money.
Merely, in the Seminar the applicant has been invited as a Chief Guest and beyond than that no role has been ascribed.
Moreover, it is submitted that the entire police report does not specify any particular role besides general allegations of alleged assurances 2 916.apl.100.2024 given by all the accused.
